name: SmartYT Media
description: URL media sniffer, candidate search, and download gear for explicit video, audio, or direct image acquisition, including Douyin and Xiaohongshu/RED URLs.

capabilities.title: Search media candidates
capabilities.description: Search for candidate media from an explicit Codex/user query and platform list, save a search task, and return candidate metadata without downloading anything. YouTube uses native yt-dlp search. Xiaohongshu uses xiaohongshu-cli with browser cookies. Douyin uses dy-cli and returns structured dependency, login, or proxy/network recovery when the local Douyin CLI route is not ready.
examples: Search YouTube for evening neighborhood walking footage
Find candidate clips for this media search plan

platforms.description: Supported values include youtube, douyin, xiaohongshu, xhs, and rednote.

cookie_file.description: Optional local yt-dlp cookies.txt path. Defaults to the SmartYT saved cookie file when configured.

codex.skill_hint: Use when Codex has an explicit media search query and platform list. This capability only returns candidates and search task state; it must not download or import media.

capabilities.title: Sniff URL media
capabilities.description: Inspect a URL and return structured media metadata such as title, platform, duration, thumbnail, extension, and available formats.
examples: Sniff media information from this video link

cookie_file.description: Optional local yt-dlp cookies.txt path. Defaults to the SmartYT saved cookie file when configured.

codex.skill_hint: Use to inspect an explicit media URL before choosing whether to download. Do not treat metadata as a content suitability judgment.

capabilities.title: Download URL media
capabilities.description: Queue a video, audio, direct image, or combined media download for a URL using yt-dlp, native image fetch, and ffmpeg.
examples: Download the video from this link

cookie_file.description: Optional local yt-dlp cookies.txt path. Defaults to the SmartYT saved cookie file when configured.

codex.skill_hint: Use only after the user or Codex plan explicitly selects a candidate or URL to download. Downloaded files stay in the SmartYT task output directory and are not imported into Media Library automatically.

capabilities.title: Download media and return files
capabilities.description: Download URL media immediately for multi-Gear workflows and return completed local artifact paths. Direct image URLs are saved as images. Douyin video URLs use the Gear-declared dy-cli route and return structured login or proxy/network recovery when that local provider is not ready.
examples: Download this video and give me the local file path
Fetch this media file now so it can be imported into the media library

output_dir.description: Optional local directory for completed artifacts. Defaults to ~/Downloads/SmartYT/<job-id>.

cookie_file.description: Optional local yt-dlp cookies.txt path. Defaults to the SmartYT saved cookie file when configured.

codex.skill_hint: Use only for an explicit selected URL/candidate. Return output_paths and task state exactly; do not call Media Library import unless the user separately requests import.

capabilities.title: Get SmartYT task
capabilities.description: Return one saved SmartYT search or download task by id, including state, source URL or query, output files, candidates, and errors.

codex.skill_hint: Use to inspect SmartYT task state before deciding the next explicit action.

capabilities.title: List SmartYT tasks
capabilities.description: List recent SmartYT search and download tasks with compact state for inspection and recovery.
examples: Show SmartYT search and download history

codex.skill_hint: Use to inspect recent SmartYT task state. This capability does not search, download, or import media.
